question_text: The figure shows a vertical cross-section of a conical flask filled with water. The height of the water level in the flask is 0.25 m and the radius of the flask at the water level is 0.20 m. The surface of water is exerted by $2.5 \times 10^3$ N. What is the magnitude of the total force exerted by the water on the inclined surface of the flask? Density of water = $10^3$ kg/m$^3$. (Take $\pi = 3$)
